name: org.openrewrite.csharp.msbuild.AlignPathCasing
displayName: Align MSBuild path casing with the repository
description: MSBuild resolves paths case-insensitively on Windows, so a solution can reference `assemblies/WPFToolkit/WPFToolkit.csproj` while the directory committed to git is actually named `assemblies/Wpftoolkit`. The same reference fails with `MSB3202` or `Project file not found` on a case-sensitive file system. This recipe rewrites path references in `.sln` and `.slnx` solutions, in `.props` and `.targets` files, and in MSBuild project files such as `.csproj`, `.vbproj`, `.fsproj`, `.vcxproj`, `.sqlproj`, `.shproj`, and `.projitems`, so that every segment matches the casing of the file or directory that is actually in the repository. References that already resolve exactly, that cannot be resolved at all, or whose casing is ambiguous — because two files or directories differ only by case — are left untouched.

name: org.openrewrite.csharp.search.ModuleHasDependency
description: Searches for .NET projects that have a NuGet package dependency matching the specified package id. Places a `SearchResult` marker on all sources within a project with a matching dependency. A source belongs to the project file (`.csproj`, `.vbproj`, `.fsproj`) in its nearest enclosing directory. This recipe is intended to be used as a precondition for other recipes. For example this could be used to limit the application of a migration to only projects that use a specific version of a package. If the search result you want is instead just the project file referencing the package, use the `FindNuGetPackageReference` recipe instead.

name: org.openrewrite.csharp.sln.RemoveNjsprojFromSolution
description: Removes Project entries with the `.njsproj` extension (Node.js Tools projects) from Visual Studio solution files, together with the configuration, nesting, and dependency entries that refer to them. The .NET SDK does not ship `Microsoft.NodejsTools.targets`, so `dotnet build` fails on a solution that still lists one of these projects.
